layer_status.persistence_evidence: UserContext is typed in TypeScript and mirrored in Python. Runtime buildUserContext derives display name/email from AuthenticatedUser and fills default preferences, but this audit did not find persisted profile/preference loading into ContextSnapshot itself.
layer_status.isolation: ContextProvider consumes the assembled snapshot rather than reaching into stores.

layer_status.persistence_evidence: WorkspaceContext and WorkspaceGuideline are typed, including storageRef and embeddingNodeId. Runtime buildWorkspaceContext currently returns a personal workspace with empty guidelines/glossary/methodologyDocs, so workspace document persistence/retrieval is not proven by code path.
layer_status.isolation: Workspace context reaches tools through ContextProvider projection when available.

layer_status.persistence_evidence: buildContextSnapshot loads a Firestore situation through getSituationAdmin(user.uid, situationId) for non-demo users and computes context health. Graph counts are derived from situation metadata, not proven live Postgres graph rows in this audit.
layer_status.isolation: Marketplace POST builds a snapshot, then passes createContextProvider({ snapshot }).forTool(tool) into the runner.

layer_status.persistence_evidence: Conversation context is intentionally session-scoped. Signed X-Praxis-Conversation-Token uses HMAC and timingSafeEqual; unsigned headers are production-disabled unless PRAXIS_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_CONTEXT=true.
layer_status.isolation: Conversation focus enters ContextSnapshot and then ContextProvider.

layer_status.persistence_evidence: withContextAware attaches X-Praxis-Context-Health, weakest-layer, and advisory headers. withCalibration passes contextSnapshot and no longer returns a 412-style context health gate.
layer_status.isolation: Context health is advisory and available to handlers through snapshot/projection.

findings.title: Production context/storage parity is not verified
findings.evidence: Production drift verifier is blocked by missing FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY; DB SQL smoke is blocked by missing pytest/DATABASE_URL.
findings.impact: Phase 1 cannot honestly claim production storage parity, extension/RLS state, or live drift posture from this self-audit.

findings.title: Two-phase Firestore/Postgres commit and reconciler are specified but not implemented
findings.evidence: Docs require pending -> Postgres -> committed and a reconciler; backlog still has the reconciler and parity snapshots open; grep found no implementation.
findings.impact: Crash recovery and Firestore/Postgres convergence are design intent, not shipped behavior.

findings.title: Four-layer context substrate has type parity but weak persisted workspace/user hydration
findings.evidence: buildUserContext and buildWorkspaceContext synthesize/default user/workspace context; workspace guidelines and methodologyDocs are empty in the runtime snapshot path.
findings.impact: Tools can receive a valid ContextSnapshot, but user/workspace-specific context richness is not yet proven from persisted substrate.

findings.title: KG embedding dimensionality is drifting
findings.evidence: graph_embeddings uses vector(1536), while MODEL_MATRIX and current architecture default text-embedding-005 at 768 dimensions.
findings.impact: Semantic search can fail at runtime or require a migration path even though audit:kg-backend passes.

findings.title: Neo4j production posture is contradictory across docs and config
findings.evidence: KG backend defaults to postgres and architecture bible says no Neo4j in v1; handoff/Phase 1 docs still describe Neo4j Aura as graph index/secret requirement; prior preflight marked NEO4J_URI missing.
findings.impact: Operators cannot tell whether missing Neo4j config is expected v1 posture or a Phase 1 blocker without reconciling source-of-truth docs.

overall.summary: Context and KG static contracts are present and the requested static audits pass when run with the installed sibling toolchain. The self-audit does not prove live production persistence, Cloud SQL schema/RLS, Firestore/Postgres reconciliation, production drift, or Neo4j secret/runtime posture.
